title: The help box gives AI answers free to anyone who leaves out the gym's sign-in key
what: A help question is paid from the gym's AI credits only when the browser sends the gym's sign-in key. A question sent without it, from a changed admin app or a plain script by an outsider, still gets an AI answer, paid by MettleUp and counted against no gym. The only limits are 20 a day per network address and 1,000 a day shared by every gym, so one person changing address can use up the whole day's help box and feedback box for every gym, and eat into the 80 dollar monthly AI cap.
expected: An AI answer only for a question tied to a gym or member that pays for it; anything else gets the help pages, and one sender cannot use up the shared daily allowance of all gyms.
who: MettleUp and every gym using the help box
how_often: whenever someone sends questions without the key
fix_line: Answer from the help pages only when no gym or member key comes with the question, and give each gym its own share of the daily limit

title: A member can log made-up workouts in the app and win a challenge's free membership days
what: Workout and kg challenges count the workouts members log in their own app, with no check that they came to the gym that day. When the challenge ends, the server adds the free days to every winner's plan by itself. A member who taps in 3 workouts a day from home, or types huge weights, reaches the goal and gets free days of paid membership. The workout-code check on the member page already matches workouts against check-ins for this reason, but challenges do not.
expected: Only workouts on days the gym saw the member count toward a challenge with a prize, or the owner approves winners before free days are added.
who: owners who run a challenge with free days
fix_line: Count a workout toward a prize challenge only on a day with a check-in, or hold the free days until the owner confirms the winners
